verbs.note: Paced and active trace use the same explicit synchronization/barrier and Event creation pattern, with 5 warmups and 10 samples. Active trace additionally resets/reads records and runs a host clock/CPU timeline. This is a two-case gate without a new post control, not proof of zero internal perturbation or an additive critical path.

note: Each backend passed matched paced/on validation. Sources, prepared benchmark, recorded MACA runtime hash, Torch, KMD/MACA version strings and common build flags match. Kernels, devices, SDKs and boots differ and remain recorded. One campaign per backend; samples are not independent campaign repeats. CPU intervals overlap across requests. GPU mapped-clock spans are approximate local envelopes, not pure network latency or an additive critical path. Same-CTA spans pair block and epoch across different role warps. Each window is reduced before taking medians; differences of medians need not add.
